title: The Global Dimension Function on Stability Manifolds
summary: In this paper, we study the reachability and boundary behavior of the global dimension function on Bridgeland stability manifolds. For a smooth projective variety $X$ of dimension $n$, we prove that the infimum of the global dimension function is $n$. This value is attained when $-K_X$ is ample, is taken by every stability condition when $K_X\in\mathrm{Pic}^0(X)$, and is not attained when $K_X$ is big and nef.
